headline: UK proposes a 100 MW indicative threshold and national decision framework for data-centre projects
summary: The Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade published an initial proposal for a National Policy Statement (NPS) for data centres in England and opened consultation through 8 January 2027. The draft describes how applications directed into the Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project (NSIP) process would be examined and decided. It says projects with at least 100 MW of rated IT load are likely to be considered nationally significant and suitable for direction under section 35, while allowing case-by-case exceptions. The proposal also sets assessment principles for energy, environment, security and local impacts. It says applicants should arrange annual operator reporting on water use and energy performance, and are expected to demonstrate design PUE of 1.3 or better, with a rationale for less resource-efficient designs. These remain draft expectations; no project decisions, facility compliance or measured effects are demonstrated.
